verses.geez: ወይእዜኒ፡ ስማዕ፡ ያዕቆብ፡ ቍልዔየ፤ ወእስራኤል፡ ዘኀረይኩከ።
verses.translation: But now hear, Jacob my servant; and Israel, whom I have chosen.

translations.lxx: But now hear, Jacob my servant; and Israel, whom I have chosen.
translations.kjv: Yet now hear, O Jacob my servant; and Israel, whom I have chosen:
translations.ron: Şi acum ascultă Iacove, sluga Mea şi Israele, pe care te-am ales!
translations.grk: Νῦν δὲ ἄκουσον Ἰακὼβ ὁ παῖς μου, καὶ Ἰσραὴλ ὃν ἐξελεξάμην.

verses.geez: ከመዝ፡ ይቤ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ አምላክ፡ ዘፈጠረከ፤ በውስተ፡ ከርሥ፡ ዓዲ፡ እረድአከ፤ ኢትፍራህ፡ ያዕቆብ፡ ቍልዔየ፤ ወእስራኤል፡ ፍቁርየ፡ ዘኀረይኩ።
verses.translation: Thus saith the Lord God that made thee, and he that formed thee from the womb; Thou shalt yet be helped: fear not, my servant Jacob; and beloved Israel, whom I have chosen.

translations.lxx: Thus saith the Lord God that made thee, and he that formed thee from the womb; Thou shalt yet be helped: fear not, my servant Jacob; and beloved Israel, whom I have chosen.
translations.kjv: Thus saith the LORD that made thee, and formed thee from the womb, which will help thee; Fear not, O Jacob, my servant; and thou, Jesurun, whom I have chosen.
translations.ron: Aşa zice Domnul, Făcătorul şi Ziditorul tău din pântecele maicii tale, şi Ocrotitorul tău: "Nu te teme, sluga Mea Iacov şi tu Israele, pe care te-am ales.
translations.grk: Οὕτω λέγει Κύριος ὁ Θεὸς ὁ ποιήσας σε, καὶ ὁ πλάσας σε ἐκ κοιλίας, ἔτι βοηθηθήσῃ· μὴ φοβοῦ παῖς μου Ἰακὼβ, καὶ ἠγαπημένος Ἰσραὴλ ὃν ἐξελεξάμην.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ አነ፡ እሁብ፡ ማየ፡ በውስተ፡ ጽምእ፤ ለእለ፡ የሐውሩ፡ በውስተ፡ በድው፤ ወእሠይም፡ መንፈስየ፡ ዲበ፡ ዘርእከ፤ ወበረከትየ፡ ላዕለ፡ ውሉድከ።
verses.translation: For I will give water to the thirsty that walk in a dry land: I will put my Spirit upon thy seed, and my blessings upon thy children:

translations.lxx: For I will give water to the thirsty that walk in a dry land: I will put my Spirit upon thy seed, and my blessings upon thy children:
translations.kjv: For I will pour water upon him that is thirsty, and floods upon the dry ground: I will pour my spirit upon thy seed, and my blessing upon thine offspring:
translations.ron: Că Eu voi vărsa apă peste pământul însetat şi pâraie de apă în ţinut uscat. Vărsa-voi din Duhul Meu peste odrasla ta şi binecuvântarea Mea peste mlădiţele tale.
translations.grk: Ὅτι ἐγὼ δώσω ὕδωρ ἐν δίψει τοῖς πορευομένοις ἐν ἀνύδρῳ, ἐπιθήσω τὸ πνεῦμά μου ἐπὶ τὸ σπέρμα σου, καὶ τὰς εὐλογίας μου ἐπὶ τὰ τέκνα σου,

verses.geez: ወይበቍሉ፡ ከመ፡ ሣዕር፡ ማእከለ፡ ማይ፤ ወከመ፡ ኵሐ፡ ዘኀበ፡ ሙኀዘ፡ ማይ።
verses.translation: and they shall spring up as grass between brooks, and as willows on the banks of running water.

translations.lxx: and they shall spring up as grass between brooks, and as willows on the banks of running water.
translations.kjv: And they shall spring up as among the grass, as willows by the water courses.
translations.ron: Şi vor odrăsli ca iarba pe malul pâraielor şi ca pajiştile de-a lungul apelor curgătoare!"
translations.grk: καὶ ἀνατελοῦσιν ὡς ἀναμέσον ὕδατος χόρτος, καὶ ὡς ἰτέα ἐπὶ παραῤῥέον ὕδωρ.

verses.geez: ወዝኒ፡ ይብል፤ ዘእግዚአብሔር፡ አነ፤ ወዝንቱኬ፡ ይኬልሕ፡ በስመ፡ ያዕቆብ፤ ወካልእ፡ ይጽሕፍ፡ በእዴሁ፤ ዘእግዚአብሔር፡ ውእቱ፤ ወበስመ፡ እስራኤል፡ ይጼውእ።
verses.translation: One shall say, I am God's; and another shall call himself by the name of Jacob; and another shall write with his hand, I am God's, and shall call himself by the name of Israel.

translations.lxx: One shall say, I am God's; and another shall call himself by the name of Jacob; and another shall write with his hand, I am God's, and shall call himself by the name of Israel.
translations.kjv: One shall say, I am the LORD’s; and another shall call himself by the name of Jacob; and another shall subscribe with his hand unto the LORD, and surname himself by the name of Israel.
translations.ron: Unul va zice: "Eu sunt al Domnului!" Altul se va numi cu numele lui Iacov. Unul va scrie cu mâna lui: "Sunt al Domnului" şi va vrea să-şi dea numele de Israel!
translations.grk: Οὗτος ἐρεῖ, τοῦ Θεοῦ εἰμι, καὶ οὗτος βοήσεται ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματι Ἰακώβ· καὶ ἕτερος ἐπιγράψει χειρὶ αὐτοῦ, τοῦ Θεοῦ εἰμι, καὶ ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματι Ἰσραὴλ βοήσεται.

verses.geez: ከመዝ፡ ይቤ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ንጉሠ፡ እስራኤል፡ ወዘአድኀኖ፡ አምላክ፡ ጸባኦት፤ አነ፡ ቀዳማዊ፡ ወአነ፡ ደኃራዊ፤ ወአልቦ፡ ባዕድ፡ አምላክ፡ ዘእንበሌየ፡ ማሕየዊ።
verses.translation: Thus saith God the King of Israel, and the God of hosts that delivered him; I am the first, and I am hereafter: beside me there is no God.

translations.lxx: Thus saith God the King of Israel, and the God of hosts that delivered him; I am the first, and I am hereafter: beside me there is no God.
translations.kjv: Thus saith the LORD the King of Israel, and his redeemer the LORD of hosts; I am the first, and I am the last; and beside me there is no God.
translations.ron: Aşa zise Domnul, Regele lui Israel şi Izbăvitorul său, Domnul Savaot: "Eu sunt Cel dintâi şi Cel de pe urmă şi nu este alt dumnezeu afară de Mine!
translations.grk: Οὕτως λέγει ὁ Θεὸς ὁ βασιλεὺς Ἰσραὴλ, καὶ ῥυσάμενος αὐτὸν Θεὸς σαβαὼθ, ἐγὼ πρῶτος, καὶ ἐγὼ μετὰ ταῦτα· πλὴν ἐμοῦ οὐκ ἔστι Θεός.

verses.geez: ወመኑ፡ መድኅን፡ ከማየ፤ ይቁም፡ ወይጸውዕ፡ ወይንግር፡ ወያስተዳሉ፡ ሊተ፡ ዘእምአመ፡ ፈጠርክዎ፡ ለሰብእ፡ እስከ፡ ለዓለም፡ ወይንግርክሙ፡ ዘይመጽእ፡ ዘእንበለ፡ ይብጻሕ።
verses.translation: Who is like me? let him stand, and call, and declare, and prepare for me from the time that I made man for ever; and let them tell you the things that are coming before they arrive.

translations.lxx: Who is like me? let him stand, and call, and declare, and prepare for me from the time that I made man for ever; and let them tell you the things that are coming before they arrive.
translations.kjv: And who, as I, shall call, and shall declare it, and set it in order for me, since I appointed the ancient people? and the things that are coming, and shall come, let them shew unto them.
translations.ron: Cine este ca Mine să vină lângă Mine, să grăiască, să proorocească şi să se măsoare cu Mine! Cine a vestit de la început viitorul? Ceea ce se va întâmpla, cine poate să le prevestească?
translations.grk: Τίς ὥσπερ ἐγὼ; στήτω, καὶ καλεσάτω, καὶ ἀναγγειλάτω, καὶ ἑτοιμασάτω μοι ἀφʼ οὗ ἐποίησα ἄνθρωπον εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα, καὶ τὰ ἐπερχόμενα πρὸ τοῦ ἐλθεῖν ἀναγγειλάτωσαν ὑμῖν.

verses.geez: ኢትክብቱ።
verses.translation: Hide not yourselves, nor go astray: have ye not heard from the beginning, and have not I told you? ye are witnesses if there is a God beside me.

translations.lxx: Hide not yourselves, nor go astray: have ye not heard from the beginning, and have not I told you? ye are witnesses if there is a God beside me.
translations.kjv: Fear ye not, neither be afraid: have not I told thee from that time, and have declared it? ye are even my witnesses. Is there a God beside me? yea, there is no God; I know not any.
translations.ron: Nu vă temeţi, nici nu vă spăimântaţi! N-am arătat Eu odinioară şi n-am vestit, când v-am luat pe voi de martori? Este oare un alt dumnezeu afară de Mine? Este un alt adăpost ca Mine?
translations.grk: Μὴ παρακαλύπτεσθε, μηδὲ πλανᾶσθε· οὐκ ἀπʼ ἀρχῆς ἠνωτίσασθε, καὶ ἀπήγγειλα ὑμῖν; μάρτυρες ὑμεῖς ἐστε, εἰ ἕστι Θεὸς πλὴν ἐμοῦ.

verses.geez: ወኢሀለዉ፡ አሜሃ፡ እለ፡ ይፈጥሩ፡ ወይገልፉ፣፡ ወኵሎሙ፡ ከንቱ፡ እለ፡ ይገብሩ፡ ፍትወተ፡ ነፍሶሙ፡ በከ፡ ዘኢይበቍዖሙ፤ ወይትኀፈሩ፡ ኵሎሙ።
verses.translation: But they that framed false gods did not then hearken; and they that graved images are all vain, performing their own desires, which shall not profit them, but they shall be ashamed

translations.lxx: But they that framed false gods did not then hearken; and they that graved images are all vain, performing their own desires, which shall not profit them, but they shall be ashamed
translations.kjv: They that make a graven image are all of them vanity; and their delectable things shall not profit; and they are their own witnesses; they see not, nor know; that they may be ashamed.
translations.ron: Toţi făcătorii de idoli nu sunt nimic şi cele mai alese lucrări ale lor nu slujesc la nimic. Martorii lor nu văd nimic şi, spre ruşinea lor, nici nu înţeleg nimic.
translations.grk: Καὶ οὐκ ἤκουσαν τότε οἱ πλάσσοντες· καὶ οἱ γλύφοντες, πάντες μάταιοι, ποιοῦντες τὰ καταθύμια αὐτῶν, ἃ οὐκ ὠφελήσει αὐτούς· ἀλλὰ αἰσχυνθήσονται

verses.geez: እለ፡ ይገብሩ፡ አማልክተ፡ ወይገልፉ፡ ዘኢይበቍዕዎሙ።
verses.translation: that form a god, and all that grave worthless things:

translations.lxx: that form a god, and all that grave worthless things:
translations.kjv: Who hath formed a god, or molten a graven image that is profitable for nothing?
translations.ron: Cine a făcut un dumnezeu şi a turnat un idol fără să tragă un folos din aceasta?
translations.grk: οἱ πλάσσοντες θεὸν, καὶ γλύφοντες πάντες ἀνωφελῆ,

verses.geez: ወኵሎሙ፡ በኀበ፡ ተገብሩ፡ ይየብሱ።
verses.translation: and all by whom they were made are withered: yea, let all the deaf be gathered from among men, and let them stand together; and let them be ashamed and confounded together:

translations.lxx: and all by whom they were made are withered: yea, let all the deaf be gathered from among men, and let them stand together; and let them be ashamed and confounded together:
translations.kjv: Behold, all his fellows shall be ashamed: and the workmen, they are of men: let them all be gathered together, let them stand up; yet they shall fear, and they shall be ashamed together.
translations.ron: Iată toţi cinstitorii lor se ruşinează; meşteşugarii nu sunt decât oameni! Să se adune toţi şi să se apropie! Ei tremură laolaltă şi simt mare ruşine!
translations.grk: καὶ πάντες ὅθεν ἐγένοντο ἐξηράνθησαν· καὶ κωφοὶ ἀπὸ ἀνθρώπων συναχθήτωσαν πάντες, καὶ στησάτωσαν ἅμα· καὶ ἐντραπήτωσαν, καὶ αἰσχυνθήτωσαν ἅμα·

verses.geez: እስመ፡ አብልኀ፡ ጸራቢ፡ ኀፂነ፡ ምሣሮ፡ ወገብሮሙ፣፡ ወበመድቅሑ፡ ደቅሖሙ፡ ወበኃይለ፡ መዝራዕቱ፡ ጸንዖሙ፤ ይርኅብኒ፡ ወይደክም፡ ወይጸምእኒ።
verses.translation: For the artificer sharpens the iron; he fashions the idol with an axe, and fixes it with an awl, and fashions it with the strength of his arm: and he will be hungry and weak, and will drink no water.

translations.lxx: For the artificer sharpens the iron; he fashions the idol with an axe, and fixes it with an awl, and fashions it with the strength of his arm: and he will be hungry and weak, and will drink no water.
translations.kjv: The smith with the tongs both worketh in the coals, and fashioneth it with hammers, and worketh it with the strength of his arms: yea, he is hungry, and his strength faileth: he drinketh no water, and is faint.
translations.ron: Fierarul ascute o daltă şi dă chip lucrului său cu cărbuni aprinşi. Alcătuieşte idolul cu lovituri de ciocan şi-i dă chip cu puterea braţului său. Lui îi este foame şi, sleit de puteri, el rabdă de sete şi este tare obosit.
translations.grk: Ὅτι ὤξυνε τέκτων σίδηρον· σκεπάρνῳ εἰργάσατο αὐτὸ, καὶ ἐν τερέτρῳ ἔστησεν αὐτὸ, καὶ εἰργάσατο αὐτὸ ἐν τῷ βραχίονι τῆς ἰσχύος αὐτοῦ, καὶ πεινάσει, καὶ ἀσθενήσει, καὶ οὐ μὴ πίῃ ὕδωρ.

verses.geez: ወኀሪዩ፡ ጸራቢ፡ ዕፀ፡ ያቀውም፡ በአምጣኑ፡ ወያስተጣግዕ፡ በኵሉ፣፡ ወይገብሮ፡ በአምሳለ፡ ሰብእ፡ ወከመ፡ ራእየ፡ እጓለ፡ እመሕያው፡ ወያቀውሞ፡ ውስተ፡ ቤት።
verses.translation: The artificer having chosen a piece of wood, marks it out with a rule, and fits it with glue, and makes it as the form of a man, and as the beauty of a man, to set it up in the house.

translations.lxx: The artificer having chosen a piece of wood, marks it out with a rule, and fits it with glue, and makes it as the form of a man, and as the beauty of a man, to set it up in the house.
translations.kjv: The carpenter stretcheth out his rule; he marketh it out with a line; he fitteth it with planes, and he marketh it out with the compass, and maketh it after the figure of a man, according to the beauty of a man; that it may remain in the house.
translations.ron: Lemnarul întinde sfoara, face un semn cu plumbul. El lucrează cu sculele lui şi măsoară cu compasul. El face lucrul lui după chipul unui om, după frumoasa înfăţişare a unui pământean, ca să fie aşezat într-o casă.
translations.grk: Ἐκλεξάμενος τέκτων ξύλον, ἔστησεν αὐτὸ ἐν μέτρῳ, καὶ ἐν κόλλῃ ἐῤῥύθμισεν αὐτὸ, καὶ ἐποίησεν αὐτὸ ὡς μορφὴν ἀνδρὸς, καὶ ὡς ὡραιότητα ἀνθρώπου, στῆσαι αὐτὸ ἐν οἴκῳ.

verses.geez: ለዝኩ፡ ዕፅ፡ ዘገዘሞ፡ እምገዳም፡ ዘእግዚአብሔር፡ አብቈለ፡ ወበዝናም፡ አልሀቀ።
verses.translation: He cuts wood out of the forest, which the Lord planted, even a pine tree, and the rain made it grow,

translations.lxx: He cuts wood out of the forest, which the Lord planted, even a pine tree, and the rain made it grow,
translations.kjv: He heweth him down cedars, and taketh the cypress and the oak, which he strengtheneth for himself among the trees of the forest: he planteth an ash, and the rain doth nourish it.
translations.ron: El şi-a tăiat un cedru, sau a luat chiparos sau stejar, pe care şi-i alesese dintre copacii pădurii, sau a plantat un cedru pe care ploaia l-a făcut să crească.
translations.grk: Ἔκοψε ξύλον ἐκ τοῦ δρυμοῦ, ὃ ἐφύτευσε Κύριος, πίτυν, καὶ ὑετὸς ἐμήκυνεν,

verses.geez: ዘያነድድ፡ ሰብእ፡ ወያነሥእ፡ እምኔሁ፡ ወይስኅን፡ ወያነድድ፡ ወያበስል፡ ቦቱ፡ ኅብስተ፤ ወዘተርፈ፡ እምኔሁ፡ ይገብር፡ ሎቱ፡ አማልክተ፡ ወይሰግዱ፡ ሎቱ፡ ለዝኩ።
verses.translation: that it might be for men to burn: and having taken part of it he warms himself; yea, they burn part of it, and bake loaves thereon; and of the rest they make for themselves gods, and they worship them.

translations.lxx: that it might be for men to burn: and having taken part of it he warms himself; yea, they burn part of it, and bake loaves thereon; and of the rest they make for themselves gods, and they worship them.
translations.kjv: Then shall it be for a man to burn: for he will take thereof, and warm himself; yea, he kindleth it, and baketh bread; yea, he maketh a god, and worshippeth it; he maketh it a graven image, and falleth down thereto.
translations.ron: Omul se slujeşte de ei pentru aprins focul şi îi ia să se încălzească. El îi arde ca să coacă pâinea, ba mai mult, tot din el face şi un dumnezeu şi se închină la el, face un idol pe care îl cinsteşte.
translations.grk: ἵνα ᾖ ἀνθρώποις εἰς καῦσιν· καὶ λαβῶν ἀπʼ αὐτοῦ, ἐθερμάνθη, καὶ καύσαντες ἔπεψαν ἄρτους ἐπʼ αὐτῶν· τὸ δὲ λοιπὸν εἰργάσαντο θεοὺς, καὶ προσκυνοῦσιν αὐτοῖς·

verses.geez: ዘመንፈቆ፡ አንደደ፡ በእሳት፡ ወበመንፈቁ፡ ጠበሰ፡ ሥጋ፡ ወበልዐ፡ ጠቢሶ፡ ጥብስ፡ ወጸግበ፡ ወተማወቀ፡ ወይቤ፤ ሐወዘኒ፡ እስመ፡ ሞቁ፡ ወርኢኩ፡ እሳቶ።
verses.translation: Half thereof he burns in the fire, and with half of it he bakes loaves on the coals; and having roasted flesh on it he eats, and is satisfied, and having warmed himself he says, I am comfortable, for I have warmed myself, and have seen the fire.

translations.lxx: Half thereof he burns in the fire, and with half of it he bakes loaves on the coals; and having roasted flesh on it he eats, and is satisfied, and having warmed himself he says, I am comfortable, for I have warmed myself, and have seen the fire.
translations.kjv: He burneth part thereof in the fire; with part thereof he eateth flesh; he roasteth roast, and is satisfied: yea, he warmeth himself, and saith, Aha, I am warm, I have seen the fire:
translations.ron: El a ars jumătate din lemne, a fript pe jeratic carne pe care o mănâncă şi se satură. Se mai încălzeşte şi zice: "Mi-e cald! Simt văpaia lui!"
translations.grk: Οὗ τὸ ἥμισυ αὐτοῦ κατέκαυσεν ἐν πυρὶ, καὶ ἐπὶ τοῦ ἡμίσους αὐτοῦ ἔπεψεν ἐν τοῖς ἄνθραξιν ἄρτους, καὶ ἐπʼ αὐτοῦ κρέας ὀπτήσας ἔφαγε, καὶ ἐνεπλήσθη, καὶ θερμανθεὶς εἶπεν, ἡδύ μοι, ὅτι ἐθερμάνθην, καὶ εἶδον πῦρ.

verses.geez: ወዘተርፈ፡ ይገብር፡ ሎቱ፡ አማልክተ፡ ዘግልፎ፡ ወያስተባርክ፡ ወይሰግድ፡ ሎቱ፡ ወይጼሊ፡ ኀቤሁ፡ ወይብሎ፤ አድኅነኒ፡ እስመ፡ አምላኪየ፡ አንተ።
verses.translation: And the rest he makes a graven god, and worships, and prays, saying, Deliver me; for thou art my God.

translations.lxx: And the rest he makes a graven god, and worships, and prays, saying, Deliver me; for thou art my God.
translations.kjv: And the residue thereof he maketh a god, even his graven image: he falleth down unto it, and worshippeth it, and prayeth unto it, and saith, Deliver me; for thou art my god.
translations.ron: Şi cu ce a rămas, el face un dumnezeu, un idol pe care îl cinsteşte şi căruia i se închină şi căruia se roagă zicând: "Izbăveşte-mă, că tu eşti dumnezeul meu!"
translations.grk: Τὸ δὲ λοιπὸν ἐποίησεν εἰς θεὸν γλυπτὸν, καὶ προσκυνεῖ, καὶ προσεύχεται λέγων, ἐξελοῦ με, ὅτι θεός μου εἶ σύ.

verses.geez: ኢየአምሩ፡ ወኢይሔልዩ፡ ወተጸለለ፡ አዕይንቲሆሙ፡ ወኢይሬእዩ፡ ወኢይሔልዩ፡ በልቦሙ።
verses.translation: They have no understanding to perceive; for they have been blinded so that they should not see with their eyes, nor perceive with their heart.

translations.lxx: They have no understanding to perceive; for they have been blinded so that they should not see with their eyes, nor perceive with their heart.
translations.kjv: They have not known nor understood: for he hath shut their eyes, that they cannot see; and their hearts, that they cannot understand.
translations.ron: Ei nu-şi dau seama şi nici nu pricep că ochii lor sunt închişi şi nu pot să vadă şi inima lor este împietrită şi nu pot să înţeleagă.
translations.grk: Οὐκ ἔγνωσαν φρονῆσαι, ὅτι ἀπημαυρώθησαν τοῦ βλέπειν τοῖς ὀφθαλμοῖς αὐτῶν, καὶ τοῦ νοῆσαι τῇ καρδίᾳ αὐτῶν.

verses.geez: ወኢይትሐዘቡ፡ በነፍሶሙ፡ ወኢየአምሩ፡ በምክሮሙ፡ ከመ፡ መንፈቆ፡ አንደዱ፡ በእሳት፡ ወአብሰሉ፡ ኅብስተ፡ ወበመንገቁ፡ ጠበሱ፡ ሥጋ፡ ወበልዑ፣፡ ወዘተርፈ፡ ገብሩ፡ ሎሙ፡ ርኩሰ፡ ወሰገዱ፡ ሎቱ።
verses.translation: And one has not considered in his mind, nor known in his understanding, that he has burnt up half of it in the fire, and baked loaves on the coals thereof and has roasted and eaten flesh, and of the rest of it he has made an abomination, and they worship it.

translations.lxx: And one has not considered in his mind, nor known in his understanding, that he has burnt up half of it in the fire, and baked loaves on the coals thereof and has roasted and eaten flesh, and of the rest of it he has made an abomination, and they worship it.
translations.kjv: And none considereth in his heart, neither is there knowledge nor understanding to say, I have burned part of it in the fire; yea, also I have baked bread upon the coals thereof; I have roasted flesh, and eaten it: and shall I make the residue thereof an abomination? shall I fall down to the stock of a tree?
translations.ron: Cu toate acestea el nu-şi face socoteală în inima sa, că este simplu şi fără pricepere, şi nu zice: "Jumătate l-am pus pe foc şi am copt pâine, pe cărbuni am fript carne şi am mâncat-o, iar cu cealaltă jumătate care a mai rămas, voi face un idol urâcios şi mă voi închina la un trunchi de copac".
translations.grk: Καὶ οὐκ ἐλογίσατο τῇ ψυχῇ αὐτοῦ, οὐδὲ ἔγνω τῇ φρονήσει, ὅτι τὸ ἥμισυ αὐτοῦ κατέκαυσεν ἐν πυρὶ, καὶ ἔπεψεν ἐπὶ τῶν ἀνθράκων αὐτοῦ ἄρτους, καὶ ὀπτήσας κρέα ἔφαγε, καὶ τὸ λοιπὸν αὐτοῦ εἰς βδέλυγμα ἐποίησε, καὶ προσκυνοῦσιν αὐτῷ.

verses.geez: አእምሩ፡ እንከ፡ ከመ፡ ሐመድ፡ ልቦሙ፡ ወይጌግዩ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ዘይክል፡ አድኅኖ፡ ነፍሱ፡ እምኔሆሙ።
verses.translation: Know thou that their heart is ashes, and they err, and no one is able to deliver his soul: see, ye will not say, There is a lie in my right hand.

translations.lxx: Know thou that their heart is ashes, and they err, and no one is able to deliver his soul: see, ye will not say, There is a lie in my right hand.
translations.kjv: He feedeth on ashes: a deceived heart hath turned him aside, that he cannot deliver his soul, nor say, Is there not a lie in my right hand?
translations.ron: El se hrăneşte cu năluci, inima lui înşelată l-a dus la rătăcire. El nu-şi mântuieşte sufletul său şi nu zice: "Oare ce am eu în mina mea nu este o momeală?"
translations.grk: Γνῶθι ὅτι σποδὸς ἡ καρδία αὐτῶν, καὶ πλανῶνται, καὶ οὐδεὶς δύναται ἐξελέσθαι τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ· ἴδετε, οὐκ ἐρεῖτε, ὅτι ψεῦδος ἐν τῇ δεξιᾷ μου.

verses.geez: ተዘከር፡ ዘንተ፡ ያዕቆብ፡ ወእስራኤልኒ፡ ቍልዔየ፡ አንተ፤ አነ፡ ፈጠርኩከ፡ ገብርየ፡ አንተ፡ እስራኤል፣፡ ኢትርስዐኒ።
verses.translation: Remember these things, O Jacob and Israel; for thou art my servant; I have formed thee to be my servant: and do thou, Israel, not forget me.

translations.lxx: Remember these things, O Jacob and Israel; for thou art my servant; I have formed thee to be my servant: and do thou, Israel, not forget me.
translations.kjv: Remember these, O Jacob and Israel; for thou art my servant: I have formed thee; thou art my servant: O Israel, thou shalt not be forgotten of me.
translations.ron: Adu-ti aminte despre aceasta, Iacove, Israele, că tu eşti sluga Mea! Te-am făcut să-Mi fii Mie slugă, Israele, Eu nu te voi uita!
translations.grk: Μνήσθητι ταῦτα Ἰακὼβ καὶ Ἰσραὴλ, ὅτι παῖς μου εἶ σὺ, ἔπλασά σε παῖδά μου, καὶ σὺ Ἰσραὴλ μὴ ἐπιλανθάνου μοῦ.

verses.geez: ናሁ፡ ደምሰስክዎን፡ ከመ፡ ደመና፡ ለኃጣውኢከ፡ ወከመ፡ ቆባር፡ ለጌጋይከ፤ ተመየጥ፡ ኀቤየ፡ ወአድኅነከ።
verses.translation: For behold, I have blotted out as a cloud thy transgressions, and thy sin as darkness: turn to me, and I will redeem thee.

translations.lxx: For behold, I have blotted out as a cloud thy transgressions, and thy sin as darkness: turn to me, and I will redeem thee.
translations.kjv: I have blotted out, as a thick cloud, thy transgressions, and, as a cloud, thy sins: return unto me; for I have redeemed thee.
translations.ron: Risipit-am păcatele tale ca pe un nor şi fărădelegile tale ca pe o negură. Întoarce-te către Mine, că Eu te-am mântuit!
translations.grk: Ἰδοὺ γὰρ ἀπήλειψα ὡς νεφέλην τὰς ἀνομίας σου, καὶ ὡς γνόφον τὴν ἁμαρτίαν σου· ἐπιστράφηθι πρὸς μὲ, καὶ λυτρώσομαί σε.

verses.geez: ለይትፈሥሑ፡ ሰማያት፡ እስመ፡ ተሠሀሎሙ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ለእስራኤል፤ ወይንፍኁ፡ ቀርነ፡ መሠረታት፡ ምድር፡ ወይወዉዑ፡ አድባር፡ በፍሥሐ፡ ወአውግርኒ፡ ወኵሉ፡ ዕፀወ፡ ገዳም፡ ዘውስቴቶሙ፣፡ እስመ፡ አድኀኖ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ለያዕቆብ፡ ወእስራኤል፡ ተሰብሐ።
verses.translation: Rejoice, ye heavens; for God has had mercy upon Israel: sound the trumpet, ye foundations of the earth: ye mountains, shout with joy, ye hills, and all the trees therein: for God has redeemed Jacob, and Israel shall be glorified.

translations.lxx: Rejoice, ye heavens; for God has had mercy upon Israel: sound the trumpet, ye foundations of the earth: ye mountains, shout with joy, ye hills, and all the trees therein: for God has redeemed Jacob, and Israel shall be glorified.
translations.kjv: Sing, O ye heavens; for the LORD hath done it: shout, ye lower parts of the earth: break forth into singing, ye mountains, O forest, and every tree therein: for the LORD hath redeemed Jacob, and glorified himself in Israel.
translations.ron: Cântaţi voi ceruri, că Domnul a făcut aceasta; răsunaţi adâncuri ale pământului; munţilor, tresăltaţi de bucurie, voi toţi copacii pădurii, cântaţi, că a răscumpărat Domnul pe Iacov şi în Israel Şi-a dat pe faţă slava Sa!
translations.grk: Εὐφράνθητε οὐρανοὶ, ὅτι ἠλέησεν ὁ Θεὸς τὸν Ἰσραήλ· σαλπίσατε τὰ θεμέλια τῆς γῆς, βοήσατε ὄρη εὐφροσύνην, οἱ βουνοὶ καὶ πάντα τὰ ξύλα τὰ ἐν αὐτοῖς, ὅτι ἐλυτρώσατο ὁ Θεὸς τὸν Ἰακὼβ, καὶ Ἰσραὴλ δοξασθήσεται.

verses.geez: ከመዝ፡ ይቤ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ዘአድኀነከ፡ ወዘፈጠረከ፡ በውስተ፡ ከርሥ፤ አነ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ዘገበርኩ፡ ኵሎ፡ ባሕቲትየ፣፡ አነ፡ ሰፋሕክዎ፡ ለሰማይ፡ ወአጽናዕክዋ፡ ለምድር።
verses.translation: Thus saith the Lord that redeems thee, and who formed thee from the womb, I am the Lord that performs all things: I stretched out the heaven alone, and established the earth.

translations.lxx: Thus saith the Lord that redeems thee, and who formed thee from the womb, I am the Lord that performs all things: I stretched out the heaven alone, and established the earth.
translations.kjv: Thus saith the LORD, thy redeemer, and he that formed thee from the womb, I am the LORD that maketh all things; that stretcheth forth the heavens alone; that spreadeth abroad the earth by myself;
translations.ron: Aşa grăieşte Domnul, Izbăvitorul tău şi Care te-a zidit din sânul maicii tale: "Eu sunt Domnul, Care a zidit lumea; singur am făcut cerurile, Eu am întărit pământul, şi cine Mi-a fost într-ajutor?
translations.grk: Οὕτω λέγει Κύριος ὁ λυτρούμενός σε, καὶ πλάσσων σε ἐκ κοιλίας, ἐγὼ Κύριος ὁ συντελῶν πάντα, ἐξέτεινα τὸν οὐρανὸν μόνος, καὶ ἐστερέωσα τὴν γῆν.

verses.geez: መኑ፡ ባዕድ፡ ዘይመይጥ፡ ምክሮሙ፡ ለእለ፡ ያነቅሑ፡ በፃውዕ፡ ወለእለ፡ ያሰግሉ፡ እምልቦሙ፤ ያገብኦሙ፡ ድኅሬሆሙ፡ ለጠቢባን፡ ወያለስሕ፡ ምክሮሙ።
verses.translation: Who else will frustrate the tokens of those that have divining spirits, and prophecies from the heart of man? turning the wise back, and making their counsel foolishness;

translations.lxx: Who else will frustrate the tokens of those that have divining spirits, and prophecies from the heart of man? turning the wise back, and making their counsel foolishness;
translations.kjv: That frustrateth the tokens of the liars, and maketh diviners mad; that turneth wise men backward, and maketh their knowledge foolish;
translations.ron: Eu zădărnicesc semnele mincinoşilor şi pe ghicitori îi fac să fie nebuni, ruşinez pe cei înţelepţi şi înţelepciunea lor o prefac în nebunie.
translations.grk: Τίς ἕτερος διασκεδάσει σημεῖα ἐγγαστριμύθων, καὶ μαντείας ἀπὸ καρδίας; ἀποστρέφων φρονίμους εἰς τὰ ὀπίσω, καὶ τὴν βουλὴν αὐτῶν μωραίνων,

verses.geez: ወያቀውም፡ ቃለ፡ ገብሩ፡ ወያጸድቅ፡ ምክረ፡ መላእክቲሁ፤ ወይብላ፡ ለኢየሩሳሌም፤ ትነብሪ፣፡ ወለአህጉረ፡ ይሁዳ፤ ትትሐነጹ፡ ወይበቍሉ፡ ገዳማቲሃ።
verses.translation: and confirming the word of his servant, and verifying the counsel of his messengers: who says to Jerusalem, Thou shalt be inhabited; and to the cities of Idumea, Ye shall be built, and her desert places shall spring forth.

translations.lxx: and confirming the word of his servant, and verifying the counsel of his messengers: who says to Jerusalem, Thou shalt be inhabited; and to the cities of Idumea, Ye shall be built, and her desert places shall spring forth.
translations.kjv: That confirmeth the word of his servant, and performeth the counsel of his messengers; that saith to Jerusalem, Thou shalt be inhabited; and to the cities of Judah, Ye shall be built, and I will raise up the decayed places thereof:
translations.ron: Eu sunt Domnul Care întăreşte cuvântul slugilor Mele şi împlineşte sfatul trimişilor Mei. Eu am zis Ierusalimului: "Va fi locuit" şi cetăţilor lui Iuda: "Zidite vor fi". Şi Eu le voi ridica din dărâmături!
translations.grk: καὶ ἱστῶν ῥὴμα παιδὸς αὐτοῦ, καὶ τὴν βουλὴν τῶν ἀγγέλων αὐτοῦ ἀληθεύων· ὁ λέγων τῇ Ἱερουσαλὴμ, κατοικηθήσῃ, καὶ ταῖς πόλεσι τῆς Ἰδουμαίας, οἰκοδομηθήσεσθε, καὶ τὰ ἔρημα αὐτῆς ἀνατελεῖ·

verses.geez: ዘይብላ፡ ለቀላይ፤ ይበሲ፡ ወይንፅፋ፡ አፍላጋትኪ።
verses.translation: Who says to the deep, Thou shalt be dried up, and I will dry up the rivers.

translations.lxx: Who says to the deep, Thou shalt be dried up, and I will dry up the rivers.
translations.kjv: That saith to the deep, Be dry, and I will dry up thy rivers:
translations.ron: Şi adâncului i-am zis: "Seacă!" Iată, îţi voi lăsa râurile fără apă.
translations.grk: Ὁ λέγων τῇ ἀβύσσῳ, ἐρημωθήσῃ, καὶ τοὺς ποταμούς σου ξηρανῶ·

verses.geez: ዘይብሎ፡ ለቂሮስ፤ ጥበብ፡ ወሐሊ፡ ወግበር፡ ኵሎ፡ ፈቃድየ፤ ዘይብላ፡ ለኢየሩሳሌም፤ ትትሐነጺ፡ ወእሣርራ፡ ለቤተ፡ መቅደስየ።
verses.translation: Who bids Cyrus be wise, and he shall perform all my will: who says to Jerusalem, Thou shalt be built, and I will lay the foundation of my holy house.

translations.lxx: Who bids Cyrus be wise, and he shall perform all my will: who says to Jerusalem, Thou shalt be built, and I will lay the foundation of my holy house.
translations.kjv: That saith of Cyrus, He is my shepherd, and shall perform all my pleasure: even saying to Jerusalem, Thou shalt be built; and to the temple, Thy foundation shall be laid.
translations.ron: Şi am zis despre Cirus: "El este păstorul Meu, el va împlini toate voile Mele". Şi despre Ierusalim am zis: "Să fie rezidit şi templul să fie ridicat din temelii!"
translations.grk: Ὁ λέγων Κύρῳ φρονεῖν, καὶ πάντα τὰ θελήματά μου ποιήσει· ὁ λέγων Ἱερουσαλὴμ, οἰκοδομηθήσῃ, καὶ τὸν οἶκον τὸν ἅγιόν μου θεμελιώσω.
